findings.explanation: Payment terms extend up to the 27th of the following month, which exceeds standard 30-day terms and delays your cash flow.
findings.suggested_change: All payments are due within thirty (30) days of receipt of the invoice.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are doing well. Thank you for sharing the agreement. I would like to propose a minor adjustment before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause, the current payment terms extend up to the 27th of the following month, which delays cash flow. I propose modifying this so that all payments are due within thirty (30) days of receipt of the invoice. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
